33dea7695c73dc9a.description: **About Bitwarden** Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at [bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/). **THE ROLE** As a Software Engineer on Bitwarden's Secrets Manager team, you will contribute to the design and development of the Secrets Manager application stack that lets developers, DevOps, and cybersecurity teams alike centrally store, manage, and deploy sensitive credentials. You'll build upon the core concepts of secrets, projects, machine accounts, and access tokens across the product suite. This role is for an engineer early in their career who wants to develop deep expertise across a breadth of languages/frameworks. You will start with well-scoped work and grow into larger, more independent ownership, with senior engineers alongside you on design, review, and the parts of the system that take time to learn. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** - **Feature Delivery:** Build well-scoped parts of features across the API, the web client, and the SDK. Take on larger and more independent pieces as you grow into the codebase. - **Learning the Security Model:** Work inside a zero-knowledge architecture and learn why it is built the way it is. Where a secret gets encrypted, what the server is allowed to see, and how a machine account proves who it is. Asking questions here is the job, not an interruption to it. - **Automated Quality:** Write tests alongside your code, and help maintain the automated suites and CI/CD pipelines that keep the team shipping safely. - **Code Review:** Take part in pull request review. Act on the feedback you receive, and read your teammates' changes as one of the fastest ways to learn a large codebase. - **Operational Support:** Help keep services healthy in production. - **Collaboration:** Work closely with Product, Design, and your fellow engineers to understand what you are building and why, and raise questions and risks early. - **Documentation:** Keep internal architecture notes, API contracts, and public open source developer documentation accurate as you work on the code they describe. - **AI-Assisted Development:** Use AI coding assistants effectively, and understand every line you ship. Generated code gets reviewed as carefully as your own. **WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN** - **Overall Experience: 3**+ years as a Software Engineer paired with AI assisted development practices - **Technical Stack - Experience** - You should be genuinely capable enough to work independently on a well-scoped task: - C# and .NET - TypeScript and Angular - Rust - **Technical Stack - Familiarity** - Relational databases and SQL, and ideally an ORM such as Entity Framework Core - HTTP and REST API design - Git, code review workflows, and CI/CD - Automated testing across unit and integration layers - **Technical Stack - Exposure** - You will pick these up here. Prior exposure is welcome, not required: - Languages such as Go, Rust and Python - Tooling such as Terraform, Ansible, and GitHub Actions - Containerized environments such as Kubernetes - Writing, consuming, and using SDKs / APIs - Languages such as C++, Java, PHP - WASM instruction format - **Growth Mindset:** You seek out feedback and act on it, you say when you are stuck rather than quietly staying stuck, and you are honest about what you do not know yet. - **Collaborative Spirit:** A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops with a globally distributed team. - **Open Source Passion:** Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet. - **Problem-Solving:** Strong problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions. **WHY JOIN US** - Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations. - Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. - We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. - Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development. **Equal Opportunity Employer** We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs. **If you enjoy being hands-on, solving hard engineering problems, and having a genuine influence on how products are built, we'd love to hear from you.**

Headquarters: Remote

Postscript is the AI-powered, all-in-one retention platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands, including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.

Our mission is to maximize the lifetime value of every shopper. We built the best-in-class SMS platform, expanded into email, and launched revenue-driving AI products you won’t find anywhere else. Now we’re building the most AI-forward team in ecommerce, and we’re just getting started.

Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator. Fully remote since 2018.
Postscript is hiring a Lead Product Counsel to own AI, privacy and data law for our platform. You will be the legal partner to the teams building AI-enabled conversations between brands and shoppers across 20,000 merchants and millions of consumers.

The ideal candidate is a curious, effective and practical attorney who will work cross-functionally to provide counsel and compliance strategies to teams across Postscript on various AI, privacy and data protection matters. They are also interested in how AI is built and deployed in marketing and advertising, and in using AI in their own legal work. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to be on the cutting edge of AI deployment and policy in marketing technology.

What you’ll do

• Own and keep improving Postscript’s privacy, data and AI programs, including the policies, consumer notices, consent and opt-out processes, data retention practices  and records behind them.

• Partner closely with product, engineering, security and marketing teams on AI, data and privacy projects, from early design through launch, and advise on day-to-day questions.

• Build privacy-by-design and responsible AI practices into how products get made, including privacy and AI impact assessments and guardrails for our AI agents, such as appropriate testing and human oversight .

• Help commercial and procurement teams draft, review and negotiate privacy, AI and data terms with customers and vendors.

• Conduct periodic privacy and AI training.

• Monitor and advise on new and proposed privacy, AI, data protection and consumer protection laws that could affect the business.

• Work closely with our in-house policy team to advocate for Postscript and our customers on new and proposed legislation.

• Advise on privacy and AI requirements in new markets as Postscript expands.

What you bring

• A JD and active membership in at least one US state bar.

• 8+ years of legal experience, preferably including in-house at a technology company.

• Experience counseling product teams on privacy and data protection, and running or materially building a privacy program.

• Strong knowledge of US privacy law (CCPA/CPRA and other  state privacy laws that followed), including service provider, processor, and controller roles and "sale" and "share." Working familiarity with GDPR.

• Experience advising on AI or machine learning products, ideally generative or agentic AI.

• Experience advising a marketing technology, ad tech, customer data platform, identity or commerce business on how it collects, combines and uses consumer data.

• Working knowledge of consumer protection law as it applies to marketing claims, AI disclosures, pricing and promotions.

• Experience drafting product terms and negotiating data processing, AI and data-use terms.

• Business sense and product intuition. You form a view quickly under ambiguity, explain trade-offs in plain language, and get to "yes, if" more often than "no."

• Curiosity and creativity. Unsettled questions interest you, and you help teams find the structure that lets a product ship rather than stopping at the risk.

• Hands-on use of AI in your own legal work, with the rigor to check what it produces.

Nice to have

• In-house experience at an ecommerce, martech or ad tech company.

• Experience with data clean rooms, measurement, retail media or third-party data licensing.

• Experience engaging with regulators (FTC, state attorneys general) or working on privacy class actions.

• Policy or legislative experience on AI, privacy or pricing.

• Exposure to the EU AI Act.

• A CIPP/US, CIPP/E or AIGP certification.

What You’ll Love About Us

• Salary range of USD $218,000-$300,000 base plus significant equity (we do not have geo based salaries)

• High growth startup - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career!

• Work from home (or wherever)

• Fun - We’re passionate and enjoy what we do

• Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity

• Flexible paid time off

• Health, dental, vision insurance

About the legal team

Postscript Legal covers messaging compliance, privacy and product law, commercial work, litigation and policy. We treat compliance as a product advantage: our approach to consent and AI eligibility is something merchants choose us for. We also help shape the rules as founders of the Ecommerce Innovation Alliance, a leading industry policy advocacy group.

The team is small and senior, and we work AI-first. We have built our own AI tools for drafting, research and review, we try new tools as they ship, and we teach each other what works. We also have dedicated internal AI operations support for design, development, integrations and larger projects. The company sets aside time for you to develop AI skills, not just licenses, because we think this is the future of how in-house legal teams will work. The tools make us faster. They do not make the call: every piece of advice still carries the judgment of the lawyer who gave it.

For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant Privacy Notice

You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.

About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 
Position Summary

We are seeking a Enterprise Account Executive to join Ping’s sales organization. The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for driving new business while expanding the right existing relationships, helping customers solve complex identity challenges tied to security, digital experience, compliance, and operational efficiency. This role works across technical and executive buying groups and partners closely with cross-functional teams to turn identity priorities into measurable business outcomes. This draft follows Ping’s internal job description guide and reflects internal role signals showing a strategic team structure, strong new-logo expectations, and solution positioning across workforce, customer, and embedded identity use cases.

You Will

• Own a strategic portfolio of enterprise accounts and build account plans that create, advance, and close high-value opportunities across enterprise, commercial, and technology organizations.

• Generate pipeline through targeted prospecting, account prioritization, executive outreach, partner collaboration, and disciplined territory planning, with a strong emphasis on landing new logos.

• Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close, aligning Ping’s solutions to customer priorities around risk reduction, cost reduction, and improved digital experiences.

• Position Ping’s identity platform across workforce, customer, and embedded use cases, including opportunities where technology companies integrate identity into their own products and experiences.

• Build trusted relationships with security, IT, digital, product, operations, and executive stakeholders to shape buying consensus and move opportunities forward.

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering, leadership, customer-success teams, and channel partners to develop account strategy, validate solution fit, and deliver a strong customer experience.

• Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, and account hygiene while operating with strong inspection, prioritization, and execution discipline.

• Represent Ping with credibility in the market by connecting industry challenges to clear business value and differentiated identity outcomes.

You Have

• 4+ years of successful enterprise software, SaaS, cybersecurity, or identity sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota in complex sales environments.

• Experience selling into enterprise accounts, including commercial enterprises, technology companies, or adjacent regulated industries.

• A demonstrated ability to generate pipeline and win net-new business through strategic prospecting and account planning.

• Success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that involve technical buyers, business leaders, and executive sponsors.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to translate technical capabilities into value tied to revenue, efficiency, risk reduction, or customer experience.

• Excellent communication, discovery, negotiation, and forecasting skills.

• A disciplined, self-directed working style with strong prioritization and follow-through.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points If You Have

• Experience selling identity, access management, CIAM, IGA, MFA, fraud, or verification solutions.

• Familiarity with industry dynamics, including digital user or customer experiences, regulatory considerations, and security requirements.

• Experience with platform, embedded, OEM, or ISV sales motions.

• Experience working with strategic partners, GSIs, or channel ecosystems in enterprise accounts.

• Knowledge of modern identity trends such as passwordless authentication, decentralized identity, or behavioral and risk-based security models.

Base Hiring Range: $112,000-$140,000 + Commission

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

• A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.

• Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.

• Regular company and team bonding events.

Our Benefits:

Headquarters: Remote - Mexico

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:

As an Accounts Payable (AP) Specialist, you’ll help ensure Samsara’s invoices and vendor payments are processed accurately, on time, and in accordance with company policies. You’ll report to the Accounts Payable Manager and support the procure-to-pay process.

You’ll partner with colleagues across the company and with vendors to resolve questions, keep payments moving, and improve AP processes as Samsara grows.

This role can be based in an office or fully remote within Mexico.

You should apply if:

• You want to make a real-world impact. Samsara helps the industries that power our world operate more safely, efficiently, and sustainably. Your work will help support the teams and processes behind that mission.

• You’re motivated to grow. You’re interested in building your AP expertise, taking ownership of your development, and learning as the business evolves.

• You enjoy improving how work gets done. You look for practical ways to make processes clearer, more efficient, and ready to scale.

• You value working as a team. You build respectful partnerships, communicate openly, and contribute to an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.

In this role, you will: 

• 

Invoice and payment processing

• Process a high volume of invoices accurately and on time.

• Process invoices in multiple currencies for domestic and international vendors.

• Partner with colleagues across the company to ensure invoices and payments are processed appropriately and in line with company policies and procedures.

• Support weekly payment runs and help ensure vendors are paid on time.

Vendor management

• Respond to vendor inquiries through the company’s email management tool.

• Maintain accurate accounts payable vendor records.

Reporting, month-end close, and cross-functional initiatives

• Reconcile account statements.

• Support the monthly AP close, including the soft-close process, AP aging reviews, and accrual preparation.

• Assist with the AP forecast.

• Prepare analyses, schedules, and presentations to support audits and tax filings.

Processes, systems, and controls

• Identify opportunities to improve AP processes and systems, and recommend changes that support scale.

• Document AP processes in accordance with policies and internal controls.

• Perform and maintain AP SOX and operational controls, and follow applicable policies and internal controls.

• Model Samsara’s cultural principles: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 2–3 years of accounts payable experience.

• Knowledge of basic accounting principles.

• Ability to manage a high volume of transactions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to partner with business stakeholders.

• Ability to identify and help resolve issues.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting or business administration.

• Experience with ERP systems; NetSuite experience is preferred.

• Zendesk experience.

• SOX compliance experience.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.
The Team: 

Upstart's Secured Lending Fraud Oversight function is the Bank's first-line fraud detection, investigation, and monitoring across the HELOC and Auto Lending business lines. As a business unit function, the team owns fraud risk identification, investigation of suspected fraudulent activity, referral package preparation, and fraud trend analysis and reporting. The fraud function operates with direct access to loan files, origination data, and dealer and channel relationships — enabling the depth and speed of investigation that the Bank's fraud risk profile demands. The team works in close coordination with the Secured Lending Quality Control function: QC analysts escalate fraud indicators identified during file reviews, and fraud analysts provide fraud-focused review support during lower-volume periods, consistent with a documented cross-utilization protocol and independence safeguards.

As a Fraud Analyst, you will own day-to-day fraud detection and investigation for your assigned product line(s). You will investigate suspected fraud across the entire loan life cycle from application through loan servicing; identify and document emerging typologies and fraud patterns; prepare escalation and SAR referral packages for review; and partner with Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Legal to strengthen fraud controls across the business. 

This is an opportunity for an experienced fraud professional who is energized by building investigation programs in a fast-paced, technology-driven lending environment — and who wants to operate at the intersection of fraud, compliance, and AI-powered risk controls.

How you’ll make an impact

• Own first-line fraud detection and investigation across your assigned secured lending product line(s), monitoring for suspicious activity and fraud indicators across application, origination, and servicing

• Investigate key fraud risks and emerging typologies, including application fraud, identity fraud (true-name and synthetic), income and employment misrepresentation, collateral fraud, and Auto dealer-related fraud patterns 

• Investigate product specific fraud typologies including occupancy misrepresentation, valuation inflation, and undisclosed liabilities or loan stacking

• Prepare comprehensive fraud escalation and SAR referral packages for review — documenting facts, evidence, typology, and recommendations

• Conduct early payment default (EPD) fraud file reviews — performing fraud indicator review on loans reaching 60+ days past due within 90 days of origination

• Monitor and analyze fraud trends across origination channels, including application fraud rates, dealer-level fraud indicators, geographic concentrations, synthetic identity patterns, and channel-level risk signals; producing fraud metrics and trend reporting

• Maintain dealer fraud scorecards (Auto) and channel-level fraud indicator tracking, including pattern-based referrals and dealer suspension triggers in coordination with Vendor Management and dealer oversight functions

• Integrate closely with the Secured Lending QC team — triage fraud-related alerts surfaced by the QC Engine's daily monitoring output; provide typology and red flag feedback to improve detection rules and origination controls

• Coordinate across Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Risk on fraud control enhancements, law enforcement information requests, and regulatory response support

• Proactively identify regulatory risks related to fraud in your product line(s) and adjacent areas, including obligations under OCC Bulletin 2019-37, FFIEC BSA/AML Manual, Red Flags Rule (12 CFR Part 41, Subpart J), 12 CFR 21.11, and product-specific fraud risk requirements

• Support examination readiness by maintaining audit-ready fraud investigation case records, typology documentation, and program evidence aligned with OCC, FDIC, and CFPB expectations

Minimum Qualifications 

• 3+ years of experience in fraud investigation, fraud analytics, or financial crimes within consumer lending, banking, or a regulated financial institution

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

• Experience investigating consumer lending fraud — including application fraud, identity fraud, income/employment misrepresentation, and collateral fraud

• Experience preparing fraud investigation case documentation — fact and evidence assembly, typology analysis, and written escalation packages for compliance or legal review

• Familiarity with SAR referral processes, 12 CFR 21.11 SAR thresholds and timelines

• Working knowledge of BSA/AML program requirements applicable to consumer lending, including CIP/CDD, OFAC screening, suspicious activity monitoring, and Red Flags Rule obligations

• Working knowledge of OCC enterprise fraud risk management and FFIEC BSA/AML Manual requirements relevant to fraud investigation and suspicious activity reporting

• Experience with fraud trend analysis — application fraud rate monitoring, typology identification, channel and geographic concentration analysis

• Ability to manage own workload, meet deadlines, and proactively communicate risk to timelines with minimal supervision

• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — able to work effectively with Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Risk on fraud escalation and control improvement initiatives

Preferred Qualifications

ABOUT THE ROLE
Our platform handles real, live conversations — and because those conversations matter, quality is critical. Small errors have real consequences. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and grow the automated testing that keeps our voice AI platform reliable.
You will build and maintain automated test coverage across backend and frontend, create automation that places and validates real test calls end to end, and measure the accuracy of the speech-to-text (STT) and text-to-speech (TTS) layers that make the platform work. WHAT YOU WILL DO
Backend and Frontend Test Automation

• Build and maintain automated test coverage across backend services and the frontend, ensuring new features ship without breaking existing behaviour.

• Integrate tests into CI pipelines so quality checks run automatically on every change.

• Work with engineers to turn real-world failures into permanent regression tests.

Voice Pipeline and Call Automation

• Build and run outbound-call automation that places test calls through the live voice pipeline, simulates realistic caller scenarios, and validates the platform's behaviour from start to finish.

• Test the speech-to-text (STT) layer — measuring transcription accuracy and how reliably the platform understands callers.

• Test the text-to-speech (TTS) layer — validating pronunciation, naturalness, and that the voice output behaves correctly.
